COMPUTER CHOICE — sound routine 2

This is the second of seven Computer Choice BASIC routines in the Spectrum Show collection. The original full CompChoice TAP was kept with routine 1 in its sibling folder. We kept the supplied List2.tap and List2.tzx exports unchanged. The four-line List2.bas listing comes from the TZX through the ZX-UX ROM LLIST reader.

The BASIC loops over eleven pairs of duration and pitch data, issuing BEEP for each pair. There are no player actions or moving pictures. We loaded and ran this routine in Fuse 48K and saved the live BASIC screen and result. The emulator ran without audio, so the images cannot show what the melody sounded like. Music is seldom photogenic, even on a Spectrum.

REPLAY.sh uses Fuse SDL, Xvfb, Python 3, Pillow and python-xlib. No native executable was built.
